description: JavaScript file for admin GUI functionalities in Revive Adserver, including access key handling, window management, form confirmation, and UI initialization.

methods.name: useAccessKey
methods.description: Handles access key activation in IE, triggers click on alt key press.

methods.name: releaseAccessKey
methods.description: Re-enables access keys after being disabled.

methods.name: initAccessKey
methods.description: Initializes access key handling for IE browsers.

methods.name: findObj
methods.description: Finds DOM element by name, id, or within frames/layers.

methods.name: openWindow
methods.description: Opens a new browser window with specified URL, name, and features.

methods.name: setTextOfLayer
methods.description: Sets the inner HTML or writes to a layer element.

methods.name: search_window
methods.description: Opens a search window with specified keyword and URL.

methods.name: help_window
methods.description: Opens a help window with specified URL.

methods.name: login_focus
methods.description: Sets focus to login username or password field.

methods.name: initPage
methods.description: Initializes page event handlers and access keys.
